_comments: Sample configuration for Microsoft SQL Server.
db_schema: set to the target schema (typically 'dbo', or a custom schema like 'SalesLT').
Table names in the generated ORM spec are schema-qualified (e.g. SalesLT.Customer).
encrypt and trustServerCertificate: adjust for your SQL Server TLS/SSL configuration.
Copy to your project root, rename to orm_skyway_config.json, and edit for your database.
model_overview: A SQL Server database object model
